title: Quietly Citrusy Peruvian Salt Cod Ceviche Clasico
description: A citrusy and tender Peruvian dish featuring salt cod, perfect for a weeknight dinner, served in a bento box. This plant-based friendly recipe uses tempering chocolate for a unique flavor.

ingredients.name: salt cod
ingredients.notes: desalted and cut into small pieces

instructions: Rinse the salt cod and cut it into small pieces.
In a large bowl, mix together the lime juice, lemon juice, and chopped aji amarillo pepper.
Add the salt cod pieces to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
While the cod is marinating, prepare the mixed citrus segments and slice the red onion.
After the cod has marinated, add the mixed citrus segments, sliced red onion, and chopped cilantro to the bowl.
Melt the tempering chocolate and drizzle it over the top of the ceviche.
Spoon the ceviche into a bento box and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional cilantro if desired.
